The letter {{AurB|b}} was the second letter of the [[Aurebesh/Legends|Aurebesh]] alphabet. It was pronounced "besh" and was equivalent to the letter /B/ in the [[High Galactic/Legends|High Galactic alphabet]].<ref name="Written Word">{{Hyperspace|url=hyperspace/source/writtenword/index.html?page=1|text=The Written Word|int=The Written Word}}</ref>

==Uses==

*[[Ordaj Besh]], a moon of [[Ordaj]], Hoth System
